posts.title: Hiya —— Type-like Role-Playing · Sandplay Bot (Interface Design)
posts.content:
**Please Watch The Video To Check The Content

//INTRODUCTION:
Sand.Rpg(Named Hiya in its first testing version) is an interactive psychological healing system that integrates Sandplay Therapy, Drama Therapy, and Role-Playing Game (RPG). Centered on the core path of "Character — Creation — Dialogue — Farewell", it constructs an immersive closed loop for psychological expression and healing.
The system initiates from the Landing Page, where the Info module collects user profiles, self-introductions, and recent distress. In the Character phase, users are guided to select roles and understand game rules, establishing a safe "virtual self" carrier for subsequent creation. Entering the Play stage, users engage in sandplay creation as their chosen role, visualizing the subconscious through object placement (featuring stylized narratives and background stories) and sandtray layout. Subsequently, within the Report & Chat module, multiple healing reports are generated in the role’s voice, and interactive Q&A facilitates emotional sorting and cognitive dialogue. Finally, the Ending/Cure stage concludes with sandtray archiving and role farewell, transitioning from virtual creation to real-world healing. It offers users a safe, non-judgmental space for psychological expression, supporting emotional awareness and inner integration.
